_comment: Portable manifest of the raw Garage Laurent marketing images committed at Garage Laurent/. No secrets, no storage URLs, no tokens. SHA-256 lets any machine verify whether a given Supabase Storage object already matches a local file (see scripts/marketing/attach-garage-laurent-assets.ts, which hashes before uploading) without re-uploading or depending on this machine's paths.
sourceDir: Garage Laurent/ (repo root, relative — resolved at runtime by scripts/marketing/attach-garage-laurent-assets.ts via import.meta.url, not an absolute path)

assets.notes: Must have a transparent background; attach script aborts otherwise.

assets.destination: Shop.bookingCoverImageUrl (converted to WebP, resized to BOOKING_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH.cover)
Shop.bookingShopImageUrl (converted to WebP, resized to BOOKING_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH.shop)

assets.file: Worn Tire in a Busy Garage.png
assets.destination: InspectionPhoto on Camille's inspection item mkt-gl-v1-ii-camille-tires (private storage)

assets.file: Close-Up Brake Rotor and Caliper Inspection.png
assets.destination: InspectionPhoto on Camille's inspection item mkt-gl-v1-ii-camille-brakes (private storage)
Not uploaded by the attach script yet — held as a pending asset for the winter Campaign (mkt-gl-v1-campaign-winter). Flagged in attach-garage-laurent-assets.ts log output.

howToVerifyOnAnotherMachine: sha256sum 'Garage Laurent'/*.png   # or: Get-FileHash in PowerShell
Compare against the sha256 fields above. A match means the file is byte-identical to what this manifest describes, regardless of path or machine.

scripts/marketing/attach-garage-laurent-assets.ts independently re-hashes and compares against whatever is already in Storage/DB before uploading — it will not re-upload or duplicate if content already matches.
